normalization.whitespace: Trim and collapse whitespace to one space
normalization.edge_punctuation: Strip only space and .,!?:;"'` from both ends
normalization.articles: Remove one leading a, an, or the followed by a space
normalization.unchanged: No stemming, plural folding, substring matching, or synonym expansion
normalization.aliases: Additional exact labels are accepted only when an explicit aliases file is supplied

denominator_policy: Observed unique cases; request/malformed/missing-field answers unsuccessful. Uncached semantic judgments excluded and counted unresolved. Missing cases excluded and flagged; valid-response-only is supplementary. No new automatic recovery. Same legacy selection for all models: last status-ok attempt, otherwise first saved attempt.
human_model_comparison_scope: Recorded human80 only, first attempt versus one model response. Three-attempt results separate.

human80.denominator_policy: Per puzzle, use actual distinct non-test participants with submitted responses and known outcomes. Give-ups, including giving up without a guess, count as unsuccessful. Unsubmitted assignments and unknown judgments are excluded and reported, not inferred as incorrect. Retain submitted responses from incomplete sessions. Deduplicate participant-puzzle rows by latest submission timestamp. Macro-average puzzle proportions, not pooled responses.

human_all155: Unavailable: human study covers recorded 80 puzzles only
generation_comparability: Saved settings are reported verbatim. Missing historical generation_settings cannot be reconstructed. Different prompt versions and settings are not evidence of identical experiments; no automatic reruns or harmonization.
